resources.string: Replacements coming up, due or past due, and the inspection deadline. Home keeps showing status either way.
Vehicle details, mileage and records: entered by you
Maintenance status and expected dates: calculated by the app
Replacement intervals: general guidelines, not manufacturer values, unless you changed them
Official inspection and recall data: not connected yet
Saves your vehicle, records and photos as a ZIP file you choose. The plate number is saved masked.
Everything on this device is replaced with the backup. Plate numbers are restored masked only. Settings are kept.
Couldn\'t import. Your existing data is unchanged.

This file isn\'t a ChaGeun backup.
Delete all data on this device?
This can\'t be undone. Export first if you want to keep a copy. Settings are kept.
Vehicle details you enter, mileage, maintenance, fuel and check records, attached photos and receipts, and app settings. Everything stays on this device. There is no account.

Your vehicle details and records are never sent. To improve the app, usage events such as “a fuel record was saved” are sent to Google Firebase Analytics without your plate number, record details, questions or advertising ID. You can turn this off in Settings › Privacy. To show ads, the Google Mobile Ads SDK contacts Google and may use your device\'s advertising ID, depending on your consent. When you ask an external AI, you see the exact text first and choose the app to share it with. Plate number, owner and location are never included.

The plate number is encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore and is shown masked. Location and camera details are removed from photos when they are attached. App data is excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.
Settings › Data lets you export everything to a ZIP file, restore it, or delete it all. Uninstalling the app also removes all data.

Maintenance intervals are general recommendations, not manufacturer values, unless you changed them. Answers from external AI apps can be wrong. Follow your owner\'s manual and a qualified mechanic for safety decisions.
Once a month, only when the mileage hasn\'t been updated for 30 days.
Only which features you use, like saving a record, to improve the app. Plate number, record details and questions are never sent.
